name: failure probability
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 系统响应超过给定性能限值的概率。

complete_examples.text: In addition, the reliability of the wheel unloading rate decreases with the increase of Cov, the failure probability of the system can reach 15% with Cov=0.3, and the reliability of system shows the time-varying reduction process with the train running.

The reliability index of wheel unloading rate decrease with the increase of train speed, the difference can reach 35% at the case of 50 km/h and 100 km/h, whereas the reliability of bridge deflection is rich, and the maximum failure probability is only 0.67%.
